title: Sodium Chloride — Identity and Composition
description: Sodium Chloride is identified by the formula unit NaCl: NaCl. Parsed deterministically, it contains Cl + Na — 2 formula unit(s), 28 protons and 28 electrons per formula unit, molar mass 58.440 g/mol.
how_it_works: The build-time formula parser tokenizes the formula (handling parentheses and multipliers), looks up CIAAW 2021 atomic weights, and sums mass, atom, proton, and electron counts. The embedded demo re-derives the same numbers in JavaScript and fails the build if they differ.
